_ordering_rationale: Order par PV: CA US (hero, plus gros marche), Sales Centers (moat distribution), CA Intl (croissance secondaire), Operating Income (cycle housing), Total Net Sales.

kpis.signal: ~93% du CA, cycle housing US en normalisation post-boom COVID

kpis.description_en: United States revenue (SCP, Superior, Horizon, NPT, Sun). ~93% of total. US housing cycle normalizing, ~5.4M in-ground pool installed base growing.

kpis.signal: ~7% du CA, expose Europe weather + macroeco

kpis.signal: Marge op 11.6% FY24 vs 16.6% FY22, cycle baissier pool construction
kpis.description_fr: Resultat d'exploitation. Marge op 11.6% FY24 vs pic 16.6% FY22. Cycle baissier sur pool construction nouveaux + remodel, partial offset par maintenance.

kpis.signal: Plateau apres pic FY22, ~$5.3Mds, demande discretionnaire molle

kpis.description_en: Pool Corp total net sales. Plateaued after $6.2B FY22 peak, ~$5.3B FY24. Soft discretionary demand (new pools, major renovation).
